info.title: Affinity API
info.description: Affinity API for software platforms connecting practices to the compounder network.

get.description: Lists canonical formulation defaults. Requires a Live Affinity internal key with formulation_defaults:read.

put.description: Publishes a formulation-level default SIG and optional compounding-reason suggestion. Requires formulation_defaults:write.

delete.description: Retires the active defaults for one canonical formulation. Requires formulation_defaults:write.

get.description: Reads current pharmacy cost evidence and Affinity marketplace prices.

put.description: Merges item changes into the shared pharmacy pricing draft by default; mode=replace replaces the complete draft. Idempotency-Key is required. Pricing does not approve or make catalog items orderable.

post.description: Publishes the current shared draft as immutable pharmacy costs and marketplace price-book versions. Idempotency-Key is required.

get.description: Reads the active organization-specific Affinity price book for one pharmacy provider.

put.description: Publishes an immutable organization price-book version for one pharmacy. mode=merge (default) applies item updates onto the active book; mode=replace publishes only the supplied priced items. Null marketplaceUnitPriceCents removes a key in merge mode. Idempotency-Key is required.

post.description: Archives the active organization price book for one pharmacy so checkout falls back to default Affinity segment prices. Idempotent when no active book exists. Idempotency-Key is required.

affinityApiKey.description: Server-side Affinity service key. Use this header when bearer authorization is unavailable.
affinityApiKey.name: x-affinity-api-key

bearerAuth.description: Server-side Affinity service key using the Bearer authentication scheme.
